description:
A high profile gag love story between Yong-Heon, who wants the world his way, and the purest, most innocent Prince in the world! 

Yong-Heon, the third son in a family of famous chefs, emerges as a next generation patisserie with his excellent skills and star power, but is in a crisis because of a scheme cooked up by his brother and rival. To make things worse, Yong-Heon is betrayed by his lover, causing him to lose his sense of taste from the extreme stress and trauma, and he is unable to continue cooking. He desperately tries to hide the truth, but remains in crisis because of persistent paparazzi. 

After having his self confidence and cooking torn away from him, Yong-Heon has lost his reason for living and now lives the fast life in despair. But on his 26th birthday, locked up in his vacation villa, he wakes up to find Keith, who appears as if sent as a present.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)
